_about: Public-domain Gardiner Spring (1785-1873, pastor of the Brick Presbyterian Church, New York, for 63 years) for the Word Hoard: Essays on the Distinguishing Traits of Christian Character (copyright and preface 1813, catalogued 1822), A Dissertation on the Rule of Faith (1844), A Pastor's Tribute to One of His Flock (1849) and First Things (New York: M. W. Dodd, fourth edition, 1855, 2 vols), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 11 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
